items.quote: Run fast bonded/nonbonded substeps concurrently with one speculative slow force evaluation using extrapolated positions
items.reason: Speculatively computes the next slow-force step from extrapolated positions while fast substeps proceed, overlapping consecutive time steps with rollback.

items.quote: process anti-diagonals of tiles, keep boundary cells in shared memory, pack multiple queries per thread block, and shard a reference database across GPUs
